name: list_team_flags_v2
description:
Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. Returns an opaque cursor for pagination.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

createdBy.description: Filter flags by the id of the entity that created them (a user or team id).

includeMarketplaceFlags.description: Whether to include Marketplace experimentation items in the paginated response. Defaults to false.

kind.description: The kind of flags to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of flags to return.

maintainerIds.description: Filter flags by maintainer user id. Repeat the parameter for multiple maintainers (any may match).

search.description: Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

state.description: The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.

tags.description: Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
